kill_fact: No kill. Every load-bearing bear number re-verifies against the primary filing (Q1 2026 6-K Ex-99.1, quarter ended 2026-03-31, filed 2026-05-21, SEC EDGAR): company-defined net cash RMB 167.5B (US$24.3B) = ~29% of the ~$82.8B market cap (bear's ~160B was conservative); revenue +6.1% YoY; GAAP basic EPS/ADS RMB 16.69 vs 16.23 (+2.8%, the bear's '~3%'); Innovative businesses -4.6% YoY and Youdao +3.8% (stagnant-drag claim true); weighted basic shares 3,198.1M ordinary (~640M ADS) make the adverse SoP arithmetic internally consistent: 10x RMB 48B FCF = RMB 480B = ~$70B = ~$109/ADS operating, and the $10-15 cash credit is a heavy haircut versus ~$38/ADS full credit, so the $110-120 floor is real and conservative. Catalyst status SOFT_EXTENDED is honest: Sea of Remnants carries only a 'Q3 2026' China window (closed beta just opened; the China release itself still needs an NPPA license, chaining the pipeline leg to the license-risk leg) and Ananta has NO committed date at all. No hidden disqualifier found: no litigation, covenant, or structured dilution; balance sheet shows zero long-term borrowings, RMB 10.96B short-term loans only. The core structural claim — real cheapness that is mostly China-cohort beta with no dated forcing function — survives attack.
corrections: (1) STALE RISK CALENDAR (load-bearing): the 'November 2026 tariff and trade-authority decision points' leg is half-defunct. The Supreme Court trade-authority ruling is NOT pending — Learning Resources v. Trump, No. 24-1287, was decided 2026-02-20 (6-3, IEEPA does not authorize tariffs) and the IEEPA fentanyl/reciprocal tariffs on China were terminated; the administration substituted a Section 122 10% surcharge (statutory 150-day cap, expiring ~2026-07-24 absent Congress) and opened new Section 301 investigations. Revenue deceleration to +6.1% (mid-single, not 'high single digits') stands. (4) STALE PRICE ANCHOR: ~$124 is stale; NTES trades ~$129.70 (2026-07-02, mcap $82.8B), compressing the stated ~2:1 asymmetry to roughly 1.4-1.5:1 against the same $115 floor / $150 base anchors.
